headline: IFC Invests $100 Million in Banque du Caire IPO for Equity Stake
summary: The International Finance Corporation invested $100 million in the initial public offering of Egypt's Banque du Caire, acquiring an approximately 7% equity stake to expand business and household financing.
why: The International Finance Corporation, part of the World Bank Group, provides financing and advisory services to private sector companies in developing countries to promote economic development.

impacts.name: Banque du Caire
impacts.why: The equity investment provides capital directly to the bank to expand its lending operations.
